title: Opening: date, names and recording setup
summary: Alcorn gives his full name and the date, 30 November 1960, at the library seminar room; the interviewers introduce themselves.

blocks.x: Okay, let's see. We're interviewing tonight at Howard Dilton Library Seminar Room 2. Let's get your name on here. Your full name, yeah. Alvin Elmore-Elko. Senior? Senior. Yeah, you got a boy named after you. Junior. And, let's see, today's date is November the... 27th. No, it's the 30th. The 30th. The last payday. Gotta be the 30th. For me it's best. Is this on here? Yeah, we're recording. You don't mind, huh? This is 1960, anyway. And, uh, how are your name?
